snippet.title: 압구정에서 이 가격? 가성비 딤섬 맛집!
snippet.description:
압구정에 있는 딤섬집 하카에 다녀왔습니다.
첫 스타트는 오이무침인데, 마라향과 고수가 올라가 있어
홍콩·중국 느낌은 확실했습니다. 다만 간은 대만에서 먹었던 것보다 조금 센 편.

시그니처로 나온 새우 튀김 딤섬은 식감은 좋은데,
위에 뿌려진 간장은 굳이 없어도 될 정도로 짠 편이었습니다.

소룡포는 육즙이 잘 살아 있어서 무난하게 만족.
산라탕은 꽤 시큼한 스타일이라 호불호는 있을 수 있지만
해산물이 들어가 있어 맛 자체는 나쁘지 않았습니다.

날치알 볶음밥은 불향도 적당하고
씹을 때마다 터지는 날치알 식감이 꽤 인상적이었어요.

마지막으로 추가한 새우 딤섬은
새우는 통으로 들어가 식감은 좋았지만
만두피가 쫀득하기보다는 살짝 물컹한 점은 아쉬웠습니다.

그래도 압구정이라는 위치를 생각하면
이 정도 퀄리티와 가격대는 충분히 경쟁력 있는 편이라
한 번쯤은 방문해볼 만한 딤섬집이라고 느꼈습니다.


하카 근처에 있는
압구정 유명 소금빵집 자연도까지 묶어서 코스로 추천드립니다.
갓 구운 소금빵 바로 먹기 좋아요.

id.description:

Jjamppong Merah sangat mengesankan, dengan keseimbangan rasa manis dan pedas yang baik dari bawang bombai dan rasa asap yang menyegarkan. 🔥

Secara keseluruhan, restoran Cina ini terasa sangat terorganisir, dan tampaknya ada cukup banyak pelanggan tetap lokal. 👍

Namun, stafnya tampak agak kurang ramah. 😂

en-US.description:
The White Jjamppong had a subtle pepper aroma that wafted up and finished cleanly to the very last bite.

The Red Jjamppong was impressive, with a good balance of sweetness and spiciness from the onions and a lively smoky flavor.🔥

The Sweet and Sour Pork used a citron jam sauce, resulting in a sweet and fragrant style!

Overall, it felt like a very well-organized Chinese restaurant, and it seemed like there were quite a few local regulars.👍

However, the staff did seem a bit curt. 😂

Ropia Hakata Store is known among Japanese locals as the "ultimate value-for-money supermarket."

In particular, the quality of the sushi, steak, and deli corner is exceptional, giving it a strong vibe of being a "food paradise" that transcends the level of a typical supermarket.

It is a hidden hot spot perfect for buying quick snacks while traveling, and where you can truly experience the atmosphere of a local Japanese supermarket.

en-US.title: A trendy new oyster bar at Noryangjin Fish Market! | I visited Oyster 101!
en-US.description:
I visited Oyster 101, a newly opened oyster bar inside Noryangjin Fish Market.

It is a standing oyster bar where you can enjoy a casual meal while standing.

It is a place where you can compare and taste a total of four types of oysters: Tongyeong oysters, Goseong triploid oysters, and imported oysters.

Triploid oysters, in particular, do not spawn, so they are characterized by their plump flesh and rich flavor year-round.

The seafood platter was well-composed, and the tomato pasta with crab innards had an addictive taste that made me keep scooping it up.

Finally, the fried shrimp was also of high quality.

Although it is on the pricier side, it is an oyster bar that justifies the price with its taste.

📍 Location

강남 역삼동에 있는 중식당 파크루안 다녀왔습니다.

저희 부부는 생일이 3일 차이라
기념일 겸 예약해서 방문했는데요.

이번에는 디너 튤립 코스 (1인 75,000원)로 주문했습니다.

코스 구성은
대게살 냉채부터 시작해서
서호식 스프, 해삼, 새우, 전복, 소고기 요리까지 이어지고

마무리는 기스면으로 깔끔하게 정리됩니다.

전체적으로 자극적이지 않고
깔끔하게 계속 들어가는 스타일이라

기념일 식사로 충분히 만족스러웠습니다.

⸻

📍 위치
서울 강남구 논현로 430 아세아타워 B1
(역삼동 파크루안)

💰 가격

en-US.title: This quality for 75,000 won? | A course meal at a Gangnam Chinese restaurant perfect for annivers...
en-US.description:
I visited Park Ruan, a Chinese restaurant located in Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam.

My husband and I have birthdays only three days apart, so we made a reservation to celebrate our anniversary.

This time, we ordered the Dinner Tulip Course (75,000 won per person).

The course consists of:

a cold crab meat appetizer,

a Seoho-style soup, sea cucumber, shrimp, abalone, and beef dishes,

and finishes cleanly with Gismyeon.

Overall, the food is not overly spicy and has a clean, satisfying style that makes you want to keep eating,

so it was a very satisfying meal for our anniversary. ⸻

📍 Location
Asea Tower B1, 430 Nonhyeon-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul

(Park Ruan, Yeoksam-dong)

en-US.title: What does dim sum taste like in Taiwan, the land of gourmet food?
en-US.description:
📍 Jin Din Rou (京鼎樓 / Jin Din Rou)
📌 Address: No. 47, Changchun Rd, Zhongshan District, Taipei City, Taiwan 104

A dim sum restaurant famous for its xiao long bao (xiao long bao) in Taiwan.
Their juicy xiao long bao and light dim sum are popular dishes, and they are especially popular with Japanese tourists.
The prices are similar to those of Korean dim sum restaurants, but the portions are a bit disappointing. Still, it's a dim sum restaurant worth trying at least once in Taiwan.

snippet.title: 미식의 나라 대만 🇹🇼추천 여행지 직접 가보니…??!! (2) ㅣ*대만 음식이 호불호 있는분들 필수 영상!
snippet.description:
미식의 나라라고 불리는 대만 🇹🇼
추천 여행지와 맛집들을 직접 다녀와서 솔직하게 리뷰해봤습니다.

이번 영상에서는 대만 여행에서 많이 추천되는 코스를
직접 다니면서 경험한 그대로 보여드립니다.

📍 방문 순서

1️⃣ 시먼딩 거리 (Ximending)
2️⃣ 펑다커피 (Fong Da Coffee)
3️⃣ 아종면선 (Ay-Chung Flour Rice Noodles)
4️⃣ 중정기념당 (Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall)
5️⃣ 하이라이 하버 뷔페 (Hi-Lai Harbour Buffet)
6️⃣ 포레스트 스파 마사지 (Forest Spa)
7️⃣ 진딘로우 딤섬 (Jin Din Rou)

대만 여행을 준비하는 분들이라면
추천 여행지와 맛집 분위기 참고하시면 좋겠습니다.

“미식의 나라 대만”이라는 말이 정말 맞는지
직접 먹어보고 경험한 솔직한 여행 후기입니다.

snippet.title: 압구정에서 이 가격? 가성비 딤섬 맛집!
snippet.description:
압구정에 있는 딤섬집 하카에 다녀왔습니다.
첫 스타트는 오이무침인데, 마라향과 고수가 올라가 있어
홍콩·중국 느낌은 확실했습니다. 다만 간은 대만에서 먹었던 것보다 조금 센 편.

시그니처로 나온 새우 튀김 딤섬은 식감은 좋은데,
위에 뿌려진 간장은 굳이 없어도 될 정도로 짠 편이었습니다.

소룡포는 육즙이 잘 살아 있어서 무난하게 만족.
산라탕은 꽤 시큼한 스타일이라 호불호는 있을 수 있지만
해산물이 들어가 있어 맛 자체는 나쁘지 않았습니다.

날치알 볶음밥은 불향도 적당하고
씹을 때마다 터지는 날치알 식감이 꽤 인상적이었어요.

마지막으로 추가한 새우 딤섬은
새우는 통으로 들어가 식감은 좋았지만
만두피가 쫀득하기보다는 살짝 물컹한 점은 아쉬웠습니다.

그래도 압구정이라는 위치를 생각하면
이 정도 퀄리티와 가격대는 충분히 경쟁력 있는 편이라
한 번쯤은 방문해볼 만한 딤섬집이라고 느꼈습니다.


하카 근처에 있는
압구정 유명 소금빵집 자연도까지 묶어서 코스로 추천드립니다.
갓 구운 소금빵 바로 먹기 좋아요.


📍 업체 정보

 • 위치 : 서울 강남구 도산대로49길 6-10
 • 영업시간 : 12:00 – 22:00
(브레이크타임 15:00 – 17:30 / 라스트오더 20:30)

en-US.title: This price in Apgujeong? A great value dim sum restaurant!
en-US.description:
I visited Hakka, a dim sum restaurant in Apgujeong.
I started with cucumber salad, topped with spicy chili peppers and cilantro,
which gave it a distinct Hong Kong/Chinese flavor. However, the seasoning was a bit stronger than what I'd had in Taiwan.

The signature fried shrimp dim sum had a nice texture,
but the soy sauce drizzled on top was salty enough that it was practically unnecessary.

The xiaolongbao were juicy and quite satisfying.
The sizzling hot pot was quite sour, which might be a bit of a hit,
but the seafood made it taste good.

The flying fish roe fried rice had just the right amount of smoky flavor,
and the roe bursting with every bite was quite impressive.

The shrimp dim sum, which I added last, had a nice texture, as the shrimp were whole,
but the dumpling skin was a bit mushy rather than chewy, which was a bit disappointing.

Still, considering its Apgujeong location,
the quality and price are competitive enough,
so I felt it was worth a visit.

I recommend this dim sum restaurant, which is located nearby, and includes Jayeondo, a famous salt bread restaurant in Apgujeong.
The freshly baked salt bread is perfect for eating right out of the oven.

📍 Business Information

Hakka
• Location: 6-10 Dosandaero 49-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul
• Hours: 12:00 PM – 10:00 PM
(Break time: 3:00 PM – 5:30 PM / Last order: 8:30 PM)
• Closed: Every Monday
• Parking: Valet parking available (fee required)
• Menu: Dim sum, Cantonese Chinese, Peking duck (reservations required)

en-US.title: What's different about Chef Song Hoon's pork? | Black and White Chef Restaurant Tour (1)
en-US.description:
I visited Crown Pig, run by Chef Song Hoon, a black-and-white chef.
The clean atmosphere from the entrance, and the open kitchen allows for a clear view of the meat preparation process.

The most notable feature of this restaurant's pork is its texture.
It's not just tender,
but each cut offers a distinctly different chew,
so you won't get bored of trying different cuts.

It's not heavy on the fat,
and the subtle sweetness develops with each bite,
making it especially recommended for those who enjoy a rich pork texture.

en-US.title: A gamjatang restaurant recommended by a real estate agent who is a native of Sillim-dong!
en-US.description:
📍 Today's Restaurant

Highly recommended by a Sillim-dong local real estate agent 🔥

Sillim-dong, Gwanak-gu, Seoul,

A restaurant that serves truly excellent gamjatang (potato stew) — "Hana Gamjatang"

🍲 11,000 won per serving.

At first, I was shocked by the price,

but when I saw the amount of meat, I thought, "Oh, there's a reason."

The meat is lean, and the broth is savory → you don't even need rice.

A true "meat + broth + portion" experience!

✅ Hangover cure, late dinner, after-work meal
Perfect for when you want a filling meal, not a light one.

📅 Business Hours: Typically 12:00 PM - 12:00 AM (Check before visiting) 
📌 Location: See address below

Please like, subscribe, and turn on notifications.

We'll be back with another truly amazing restaurant! 🙏

🏠 Hana Gamjatang (Sillim Branch)

24 Sillim-ro 65-gil, Gwanak-gu, Seoul
(Public Transportation: Approximately a 5-minute walk from Exit 7 of Sillim Station (Subway Line 2)
